newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin to leave hospital for country home Friday.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin to leave hospital for country home Friday.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin will leave hospital for the Barvikha complex of country houses and government rest homes on Friday, the presidential press service said.

A spokesman said Yeltsin, who is recovering from a heart bypass operation, would spend two or three weeks at Barvikha, just outside Moscow. The president appeared on Russian television on Wednesday for the first time since the bypass operation.
The press service said Yeltsin, 65, could return to work in the Kremlin by the end of this year.
The spokesman said the president was feeling well and his recovery from the November 5 quintuple bypass was in line with doctors' expectations.
Yeltsin said on Wednesday that he was in fighting mood after his operation and would return to work after a spell in the Barvikha sanatorium.
